check.feedback_en: 1: Prioritize safety and timely help. 2: Necessary assessment may be delayed. 3: The shortcut can cause harm: Do not label the illness, wait for every sign, or give anything by mouth to a child who cannot safely swallow.

check.prompt_fil: Ano ang dapat ipakita sa practice?

options.fil: Ulitin ang shortcut kahit may panganib at walang kumpirmadong tagubilin.
options.en: Repeat the shortcut despite the risk and without confirmed guidance.

options.fil: Magbigay ng diagnosis mula sa kuwento at mangakong sapat na iyon para sa pasyente.
options.en: Diagnose from the story and promise it is enough for the person.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Ang shortcut ay hindi ligtas: Huwag magbigay ng diagnosis, maghintay ng lahat ng senyales, o magpainom sa batang hindi ligtas lumunok. 2: Obserbahan ang gawa at ang tamang referral. 3: Hindi batayan ang kuwento para sa sariling diagnosis.
check.feedback_en: 1: The shortcut is unsafe: Do not label the illness, wait for every sign, or give anything by mouth to a child who cannot safely swallow. 2: Observe the task and appropriate referral. 3: The story is not grounds for an independent diagnosis.

narration_en: On Monday, use the same checklist with a new fictional case. Record observations and the confirmed contact. Identify at least one danger sign, activate urgent referral and repeat the observation in a factual handover.
